questions.query: Using the preceding investigation and the fixed llvm-project snapshot, investigate this edge case: target and language options that change the selected tool chain or forwarded arguments. Reproduce it with the relevant files in clang/test/Driver or a minimal fixture. Make an isolated fix only when the evidence requires one. If changing code, list every changed file and run the narrowest applicable repository test; if no fix is justified, give the evidence and leave the source unchanged. Report test output and unresolved conditions in ja.

For Clang driver option parsing and tool-chain selection in the fixed llvm-project snapshot, trace the public API, configuration, or downstream impact. Combine the first two task results, inspect clang/lib/Driver/Driver.cpp, clang/lib/Driver/ToolChains, and check clang/test/Driver. Explain compatibility assumptions, affected callers or documentation, migration/rollout implications, and the smallest additional test needed. Do not treat a similar name or path as proof of equivalence. Respond in ja.

For Clang driver option parsing and tool-chain selection in the fixed llvm-project snapshot, audit the interaction of --target, -x, and -fsyntax-only. Trace the argument parsing, final phase, toolchain selection, and job construction boundaries in clang/lib/Driver/Driver.cpp and clang/lib/Driver/ToolChains. Check the relevant clang/test/Driver expectations. Explain which previously established facts remain applicable and which additional evidence is required. Do not claim an installed compiler reproduces this snapshot without verifying its build. Give source-grounded behavior, a no-change or justified-fix decision, and a bounded conclusion for anything not reproducible. Respond in ja.
